insights.one_liner: Fast-growing US data and AI platform company valued at US$190 billion; 22 roles here, nearly all in Amsterdam, 91% in English, mostly senior.

culture.text: Staff mostly studied computer science, often at Berkeley, Georgia Tech, Carnegie Mellon, Stanford or Washington.

growth.text: Grew more than 80% year on year and passed a US$7 billion revenue run-rate.
Had about 4,000 staff in 2022; LinkedIn now lists about 17,109.
Raised US$5 billion more, at a US$190 billion valuation, with an IPO seen as inevitable.
Bought spreadsheet startup Row Zero and is scouting for more acquisitions.

worth_knowing.text: Apply only via its official careers page; real messages come only from @databricks.com or @goodtime.io addresses.
